faults.boundary: Boot/lock: Kill/error after writer lock acquisition but before journal open.
faults.required_result: New process reacquires lock; no Redis attach/effect occurred.

faults.boundary: Journal create: Crash after new journal header write but before file sync.
faults.required_result: No readiness/effect; restart either sees invalid/uncommitted state and fails closed or valid header after explicit recovery policy.

faults.boundary: Directory durability: Crash after journal file sync but before parent-directory fsync on first creation.
faults.required_result: No PaperReady/consumer attach before directory fsync barrier.
faults.exception_rationale: The production ordering is enforced statically and by a negative mutation; no portable process-level harness can deterministically stop between file sync completion and parent-directory fsync while also proving power-loss persistence semantics.

faults.boundary: RequestAccepted: Kill immediately after RequestAccepted fsync.
faults.required_result: Restart/redelivery has one accepted record; may append missing dispatch once; no duplicate accepted.

faults.boundary: DispatchAttempt: Kill immediately after DispatchAttemptRecorded fsync before provider.
faults.required_result: Restart is ReconciliationRequired/hold; no blind redispatch.

faults.boundary: Provider boundary: Kill during/after provider effect before durable outcome append.
faults.required_result: Restart is ReconciliationRequired/hold; provider not blindly reinvoked.

faults.boundary: Outcome record: Kill immediately after durable outcome append.
faults.required_result: Restart reconstructs finalization/canonical ACK without provider.

faults.boundary: RequestFinalized: Kill immediately after RequestFinalized fsync.
faults.required_result: Restart reconstructs canonical ACK; no provider.

faults.boundary: Seal temp write: Crash while writing replacement recovery-seal temp file.
faults.required_result: Old committed seal remains authority; temp ignored.

faults.boundary: Seal temp sync: Crash after temp seal sync but before rename.
faults.required_result: Old committed seal remains authority; synced temp not auto-promoted.

faults.boundary: Seal rename: Crash after atomic rename but before parent-dir fsync.
faults.required_result: Restart accepts only a fully valid canonical old/new committed seal; never temp/partial data.
faults.exception_rationale: The rename-to-directory-sync ordering is enforced statically and by a negative mutation; the restart witness separately proves that only exact canonical committed seal authority is accepted.

faults.boundary: Pre-settlement: Kill after valid recovery seal but before ACK settlement.
faults.required_result: PEL remains; restart settles canonical ACK once.

faults.boundary: Settlement response loss: Redis settlement commits but client receives injected unknown/error.
faults.required_result: Redis PEL/settlement marker resolves outcome; no duplicate canonical ACK.

faults.boundary: ACK Redis outage: ACK settlement backend unavailable.
faults.required_result: PEL remains; readiness degraded; no XACK.

faults.boundary: DLQ Redis outage: DLQ settlement backend unavailable.
faults.required_result: Poison entry remains pending; readiness degraded; no XACK.

faults.boundary: PEL recovery: Kill new process during XAUTOCLAIM recovery.
faults.required_result: Next boot can reclaim again; execution identity unchanged; no blind effect.

faults.boundary: Writer death: SIGKILL/abrupt kill of lock holder.
faults.required_result: Kernel lock releases; next process acquires and validates storage before Redis attach.

faults.boundary: External mutation: Modify journal externally while service owns it.
faults.required_result: Next append/read validation detects mutation and blocks effects.

faults.boundary: Durability uncertain: Inject journal sync failure after full frame bytes written.
faults.required_result: No append receipt/effect; current process locked out; restart validates actual disk state conservatively.

faults.boundary: Lagging Stage5 seal: Restart with non-final Stage6 request absent from Stage5 package.
faults.required_result: RecoveryBlocked; no effect/ACK/DLQ/XACK; no journal truncation.
